scientific_integrity: The published Monge vertex characterization and classical Gaussian-maxima tools are credited. The asymptotic rare-vertex correction is derived in the accompanying result; finite checks are not a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Two-row nonsymmetric normalized Monge polytope only.
The 2026 volume/Ehrhart work was compared from its abstract, not its full text.
No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
title: A sharp rare-vertex mean-width correction for two-row Monge polytopes
